Neither plant insurance nor a loyalty points program are covered in our policies. However, we do offer:

- **Leafy Plus membership** ($59/year): includes a 90-day guarantee (vs. 30 days standard), free Standard shipping with no minimum, free change-of-mind returns, and 10% off pots and accessories.
- **Plant Club subscription** ($29–$49/month): a monthly surprise plant delivery tailored to your light level.

If you'd like details on either, I'm happy to help—or you can reach our team at **help@leafy.example** (answered within 1 business day) or chat **8am–8pm Mon–Sat** (your local time). Would either of these interest you?
